title: 910. 3Sum With Multiplicity

examples.explanation: Twenty index triplets (i < j < k) have values summing to 8.
Each choice of one of the two 1s, one of the four 2s... triplets of values (1,2,2) give 2 * 6 = 12.
Only the triplet using all three positions sums to 6.
